1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeConeBudget
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeConeCoverage
3 
4 /-! The cumulative source-angle budget, now proved from the actual
5 surface geometry rather than assumed as cone-coverage data. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
8 
9 open Set Real
10 
11 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
12     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
13       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
14     {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
15     [Fintype T.vertices] [DecidableRel T.graph.Adj]
16     (models : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeMetricModel T d.adj)
17 
18 include small_faces in
19 /-- All directed source angles together are bounded by the source's actual cone angle. -/
20 theorem source_angle_sum_le (source : Fin 6)
21     (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space)) :
22     ∑ d, (models d).sourceAngle ≤ graph.totalAngleAt source :=
23   graph.source_angle_sum_le_of_cone_coverage small_faces T models source at_source
24     (graph.incident_model_angles_cover_cone small_faces a T models)
25 
26 include small_faces in
27 /-- Counting each kite once gives a total source-angle budget strictly below π. -/
28 theorem half_source_angle_sum_lt_pi (source : Fin 6)
29     (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space)) :
30     (∑ d, (models d).sourceAngle) / 2 < π :=
31   graph.half_source_angle_sum_lt_pi_of_cone_coverage small_faces T models source at_source
32     (graph.incident_model_angles_cover_cone small_faces a T models)
33 
34 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
